skill.summary: Get YouTube-ready videos ready to post, without touching a single slider. Upload your text or script (TXT, DOCX, PDF, copied text, up to 500MB), say somethin...

latestVersion.changelog:
AI Text to YouTube 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly converts text, scripts, or documents into ready-to-publish YouTube videos with visuals and voiceover.
- Supports uploads via TXT, DOCX, PDF, pasted text (up to 500MB); outputs 1080p MP4 files.
- Handles session management, cloud rendering, and error recovery automatically.
- Includes built-in credit checking, export/download, and state tracking features.
- Clear prompts and status updates guide users through the video creation process.
